text_block_list.text:
Training with Tokai Teio had wrapped up, 
and we were just about to head home...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I'm beat~. I was feeling so good, I 
ended up running way too much~
choice_data_list: Let's go home and get plenty of rest.
Let's go home and get plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Take a shower and—... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo, Prez! What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Teio. I was just about to inspect the 
course for the upcoming Fan Thanksgiving.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Checking the track? At this hour? And the 
President is doing it alone?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I'll help too! With me 
and Prez, we'll be done in no time♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the sentiment, but... you've 
only just finished training. Aren't you 
exhausted?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, it's a piece of cake! Right, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay! Alrighty! Let's get this cleaned 
up in a jiffy!

True to Tokai Teio's enthusiastic words, 
the inspection was wrapped up in no time 
at all.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Phew! That's all the measurements taken!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Teio. Thanks to you, it looks 
like we'll finish quite a bit earlier than 
expected.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Go on, you can clock out for today. I can 
handle the rest by myself.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Isn't it done once you take the 
measurements?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We're just running the course to get a 
reference time. I can't let you push 
yourself when you look completely 
exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That's... but, but! Hmmmmm............

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, wait here a second! I'll be right 
back!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa! Thanks for waiting! That should 
solve the problem!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Your Racewear...? Why did you put that 
on?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I didn't take on helping Prez because 
someone asked— I told her that *I* wanted 
to do it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Giving up halfway on that? No freaking 
way!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"This racing attire is a declaration of my 
will to never give up on what I've set my 
mind to!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"As long as I'm wearing this outfit, I 
won't lose! Just watch me. I'll definitely 
run all the way to the end!"

As if all her earlier fatigue had been an 
illusion, Tokai Teio finished the course 
with an incredible run!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Did you see that, Prez? Told you I 
could do it!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent, Teio! I bore full witness to 
your indomitable running.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see... Just as you described, the power 
within that racing outfit seems to be the 
real deal.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, yeah! That's why—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even in a race, I'll win! Even if my 
opponent is the President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ho... In that case, there's no time like 
the present. How about a mock race 
tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I have done nothing but decline your 
invitations on the pretext of being busy. 
For once, allow me to extend an 
invitation."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a mock race!? Well... I-I'm happy 
about it, but...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...No, not right now! Because I want to 
compete on a real, proper big stage.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
……Whoops, I'm pretty worn out after all. 
I'm heading back! Let's go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"On the grand stage," huh... Calling your 
growth a "fast sprint" doesn't even begin 
to do it justice.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Besides, seeing you just now, you're the 
very picture of tireless devotion! I can't 
afford to slack off either, it seems... 
haha!

Tokai Teio had splendidly completed her 
task of assisting Symboli Rudolf, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
choice_data_list: Are you worn out after all?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: No, no, no~! Ahhh~...! What have I done~?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"And after the President went out of her 
way to invite me to a mock race, too...!!"
choice_data_list: You're competing on a proper stage, right?
You're competing on a proper stage, right?

If we're going to compete, we need 
preparation!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"And after the President went out of her 
way to invite me to a mock race, too...!!"
choice_data_list: You're competing on a proper stage, right?
You're competing on a proper stage, right?

If we're going to compete, we need 
preparation!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I mean, yeah, but...
choice_data_list: First, we have to reach that stage.
First, you have to reach that stage.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Right! You're right! First, I need 
to stand on the same stage as the 
President!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm all fired up!! Let's do our 
best, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's true. I said I won't lose, but 
there's no way I'll win without preparing.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... But I'm so excited! Running with 
the President!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's surpass the President 
together, Trainer!
